query: UPDATE kb_chunks SET embedded_with = $1 WHERE id = ANY($2) AND kb_chunks.is_current AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_content_blocks b WHERE b.id = kb_chunks.block_id AND NOT b.is_folded FOR KEY SHARE) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_resources r WHERE r.id = kb_chunks.resource_id AND r.erased_at IS NULL FOR KEY SHARE)
